description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used.

description.zh:
要查询的RAM角色名称。取值固定为**AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole**，表示DDoS高防服务的默认角色。

> DDoS高防服务默认使用此角色来访问您在其他云产品中的资源。
description.en:
The name of the RAM role that you want to query. The value is fixed as **AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole**, which indicates the default role of Anti-DDoS Proxy.

> Anti-DDoS Proxy use this role by default to access your resources in other cloud services.

title.zh: 查询是否授权访问其他云产品

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于查询当前阿里云账号是否已授权DDoS高防服务访问其他云产品。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation queries whether your Alibaba Cloud account has authorized Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium to access other cloud services.

### QPS limits

The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) for this operation is 10 per user. If the number of API calls exceeds this limit, throttling is triggered. This may affect your business operations. Ensure that you call this operation at an appropriate rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-sts-grant-status --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --role AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
